title: Northgate Optical Replacement Percentage by Months on the Replacement Clock
content:
**Northgate Optical — replacement percentage for accidental damage replacements.** Where no more than 6 whole months have passed since the replacement clock start, the replacement percentage is 20 percent, and where 7 to 9 whole months have passed, it is 25 percent. Beyond 9 whole months this table sets no percentage.

| Whole months since the replacement clock start | Replacement percentage |
|---|---|
| 0 to 6 | 20 percent |
| 7 to 9 | 25 percent |

**Counting.** The months are whole months between the replacement clock start and the day the replacement is authorized; a part month is not counted.

### Reading the edges

| Whole months passed | Percentage |
|---|---|
| 6 | 20 percent |
| 7 | 25 percent |
| 9 | 25 percent |
| 10 | outside this table |

Example (hypothetical): with a replacement basis of 200.00, 20 percent is 40.00 and 25 percent is 50.00.
